source.description: Supplementary Table S4 (annotated differentially expressed genes per treatment vs Larvae Only control)
source.citation: Hesser J, Mueller RS, Langdon C, Schubiger CB (2024). Immunomodulatory effects of a probiotic combination treatment to improve the survival of Pacific oyster (Crassostrea gigas) larvae against infection by Vibrio coralliilyticus. Front Immunol 15:1380089. https://doi.org/10.3389/fimmu.2024.1380089

transformation_notes: Identifiers preserved verbatim, including the 'gene-LOCxxxxx|LOCxxxxx' decoration used by the source; harmonize.identifiers resolves the embedded stable id.
The source reports only log2FoldChange and a BH-adjusted p-value, so lfcSE and the raw p-value are empty. Meta-analysis weighting that requires a standard error cannot use this study.
The source table lists only ANNOTATED DEGs passing the authors' |log2FC| >= 2 and padj < 0.05 thresholds, not the full DESeq2 result. This is a truncated, significance-filtered table.
Sheet '18hrPB+Vc v LOnly' of the published file contains a repeated header row part-way down (source row 71); it is dropped by the numeric coercion step and counted as rows_dropped_non_numeric.
Sheet '18hrPB v LOnly' (probiotic only, no pathogen) was not converted: it has no stressor, and the AREE stressor ontology has no term for a beneficial-microbe exposure.
